costs.text: 1,000 EUR a position in whole shares (what the stake buys at the entry price, rounded down); on each buy and each sell Bolero's fee (2.50 EUR up to 250 EUR, 5.00 EUR up to 1,000 EUR, 7.50 EUR up to 2,500 EUR) and the stock exchange tax (TOB) of 0.35%

trading.rule: long when the predicted bin is in the upper half: the stake bought at the previous close, sold at the day's close, a fee on each leg; flat otherwise
trading.hold_rule: the same calls, but a position is kept while the calls stay up and sold at the close of the last up day: one fee pair per run, the stake compounds
trading.open_rule: the same calls, but the stake is bought at the session's open and sold at its close, a fee on each leg: the rule a reader of the page can follow
trading.short_rule: with shorts on, a bin in the lower half is a short: sold at the previous close and bought back at the day's close (daily), kept while the call stays down (hold), sold at the open and bought back at the close (open to close); paper only - selling what one does not own needs a margin or derivatives account

guarded.rule: the week call is the permission, the daily call the trigger: a coin the week's followed row calls up is bought at the entry of the first day of the week whose daily call for it is up, held while the daily call does not turn flat or down (a day without a daily call keeps a held position and buys nothing), sold at the close of the first day whose daily call is flat or down, bought again on the next up call, sold at the week's close at the latest; consecutive held days are one position, one fee pair, the stake scaled by a sized week row's size
